$comment: The Pattern Grid's twelve cell slugs (rfc-decision-cce3c00e). One source of truth: the Decision Compass (#461), the decision-record guard (check-decision-cell-tags.mjs), and the RFC-integration checker (check-rfc-integration.mjs) all read this file rather than each hardcoding their own copy (srs#462). `glyphs` is the zodiac glyph for the cell at the same array index, in the reading order fixed by the Compass's grid table (docs/charter/decision-compass.md: Individual row Fire→Water, then Relational, then Systemic) — added for srs#716 so a PR classification line's glyph (‘♒ Conformance’) resolves without a second hardcoded copy of the twelve names.
